obligation_candidates.canon_label: Use deterministic wording in this research stream.
exact_tokens: Use deterministic wording in this research stream.
Do not use hedge words such as `optional`, `maybe`, or similar softeners when describing canonical design direction.
When a rule is established, state it directly.
When a point is still unresolved, state that it is unresolved rather than softening the recommendation.
The ledger should preserve firm contract language instead of drifting into ambiguous wording.
notes: This is a wording discipline rule for planning documents. When writing contracts and rules in Contracts_V0 and UI_Command_Catalog, use deterministic language — state rules directly, use 'unresolved' when unresolved rather than hedging.
